_conditions.~4290: Place Rune of Elements in the planning-table slot for Brax's Plane of Elements.
Place Rune of The Willow in the planning-table slot for Plane of the Willow.
Place Rune of the Celestial in the planning-table slot for Soluna's Celestial Plane.
Place Rune of Honor in the planning-table slot for Vitheo's Plane of Valor.

quests.~4076:
An old Hermit in Fernalla's Field has asked you to recover an old toolbox from a group of bandits who are passing through the area. 

If you are able to recover it, bring it back to him at his home.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to A Hermit.

flags.~4082: What sorcery is this... that is not mine! I have mine here!

quests.~4076:
There is a magical sword to be had in Port Azure. 

Find a Ruby and two Seaspices for Tristian, who is loitering in the back lots of the houses near the main gate.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Tristan Warton.

quests.~4076:
Ludo Luxo in Hidden Hills has asked for you to find a Sivakayan Horn from the Bonepits - a cave on the north side of Hidden Hills. 

They make great sharpening stones.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Ludo Luxo.

quests.~4075: A Skeleton Eye for Alyssa Fearnon
quests.~4083: A Skeleton Eye for Alyssia Fearnon
quests.~4076:
Return a Skeleton Eye to Alyssia Fernon in Hidden Hills. 

She has warned you that they're hard to come by, but every now and then you'll find one on a skeleton of any sort. 

She suggested searching in the cave on the north side of Hidden Hills.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Alyssia Fearnon.

quests.~4076:
You've earned the favor of a mysterious brotherhood by finding their lost friend.

Per their instructions, you should make your way to the sandbar beneath the statue of Vitheo for a ride to the mainland.
Liani Bosh in Port Azure has asked you to forge an Angler's Ring. With it, you can buy a trip back to Stowaway's Step.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Liani Bosh.

flags.~4082: You have another? How?

quests.~4076: Ghostly beings of Erenshor can leave behind Aetheria if you destroy them. If you find any, Saya Seawatcher in Vitheo's Watch says she has a unique reward for you.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Saya Seawatcher.

flags.~4082: Thanks, I don't need any more though!

quests.~4076: Albixt Munger in Silkengrass fears that his missing wife is now one of the risen pilgrims in the area. If you find her engagement ring on one of them, return it to him for a reward.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Albixt Munger.

flags.~4082: This is not it, I already have it.

quests.~4076:
Alice Hewer's necklace was eaten by a small crocodile near the lighthouse! 

If you find it, she would like for you to bring it back to her.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Alice Hewer.

flags.~4082: You've already given me my necklace back. This one's not mine... weird that you found two!

quests.~4076:
Rumors of methods to access the Ethereal Planes have been persistent throughout history. 

There may be a way to reach places not meant for humans, and reap the rewards within.

steps.~4076: Travel to Plane of the Willow.
Travel to Brax's Plane of Elements.
Travel to Vitheo's Plane of Valor.

quests.~4076:
Aragath claims to have been imprisoned by a group of necromancers. He thinks they're behind a hidden door in the Island Tomb near a Stone Throne. 

Destroy the necromancers and collect their soul-stones, and reunite those stones with their linked watchlights to absorb their power.

Return the four charged stones to Aragath.

flags.~4082: I will leave shortly, thank you.

quests.~4076:
A group of necromancers in the island tomb claim to be holding a demon named Aragath captive through magic. 

They have asked you to hand the demon an empty soulstone, to absorb his power and finally allow them to leave the island.

flags.~4082: I do not need anything else from you. Thank you for your help.

quests.~4076: You've given a Planar Stone to the Master of Battle in Vitheo's Plane of Honor in exchange for a token to enter the Arena.
A strange hermit in Azynthi's Garden has taken note of you shouting his name. He asked you to speak it to him in person.

flags.~4082: I hear you!

quests.~4076: Finkle Maplebottom in Hidden hills has asked for four Molorai Axes

A fisherman has brought you to a small island he happened upon. He claims that the Island matches the description of the lost Bellwain Isle, where a 100-year wanted Pirate retired into hiding with his wife with all of his treasures. 

The fisherman claims to have disturbed nothing, but something mysterious lingers in the air.
You've found some lost letters meant for Captain Bellwain, and you've given them back to Bellsie Bellwain.

~4781.note: Bellsie Belwain spawns after quest completion

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Bellsie Belwain.

flags.~4082: Thanks again.

quests.~4076: You've handed the lost love letters to Bellwain, but he told you they were not his to take.

~4781.note: Captain Bellwain spawns after quest completion

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Captain Bellwain.

flags.~4082: Thanks again.

quests.~4076:
Trevor Urchand in Hidden Hills is doing research on Eldoth Molorai. He suspects Eldoth has ties to the resurgence of Necromancy on Erenshor, but needs to know more. 

He says that there may be Necromancers in the Bonepits, and should you find any of their ritual books, he'd like you to bring it to him.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Trevor Ulchand.

flags.~4082: Thanks again for your help.

quests.~4076: Fredrick in Port Azure would like bear meat.
You've found a strange boatman in The Blight and presented your found "Boat Pass" to him. He will grant you passage to Azynthi's Garden now, at your leisure.

flags.~4082: Eldoth does not appreciate redundancy.

quests.~4076: Finkle Maplebottom in Hidden hills has asked for four Ancient Bones.

Braxon Elden in the Braxonian Desert has expressed interest in the scent of Brashell emanating from the covered well that has been recently excavated. 

If you you happen across any Brashell in your explorations, Braxon Elden may be interested in seeing it.

flags.~4082: It's so interesting to see this!

quests.~4076: You destroyed the Flame Warder in the Plane of Brax
You destroyed the Ice Warder in the Plane of Brax
You showed the two pieces of the Braxonian Portal to Braxon Elden, and he was able to combine them.
You need to find an Eldrich Crystal to power the Rune of Brax, and offer both items to the energy source at his Portal.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Elemental Energy.

quests.~4076: You showed the writings from Fallen Braxonia to Braxon Elden, and he was most impressed.

flags.~4082: Ah, these are not new... just copies of what you've shown me.

quests.~4076:
Brackfruit Breaded Island Fin
1 Island Fin
1 Brackfruit Juice
1 Bread
1 Coal
You're not even sure if this really happened.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Odd Statue.

quests.~4076: A Guard in Port Azure has offered you the job of Reliquary Caretaker. All you have to do is go inside and make sure everything is in order. After that, you can do whatever you'd like with it.

~4998.~4290: Take it from the planning table's portal slot.

quests.~4076: William Cardigo has asked you to find out what lurks in the Bonepits and clear it out before it emerges into Willowwatch.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to William Cardigo.

flags.~4082: Thanks, but you gave me one of these already.

quests.~4076:
A note was given to you by a strange hermit in Fernalla's Revival Plains. Its addressed to a C. Pillot. 

Find him, wherever he is, and deliver the note.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Chazz Pillot.

flags.~4082: We've already been though this.

quests.~4076: You gave a tiny statue of a talking cat to a ghostly talking deer in a dream, and the deer gave you a nightmare.

~4781.note: The Conductor spawns after quest completion

steps.~4076: Turn in items to The Conductor.

flags.~4082: No thank you I have one already!

quests.~4076: The Rottenfoot Poachers have asked for Croc tails
Edgar in Silkengrass has promised a generous reward for any Sivakayan Axes or Swords or Sceptres that you're able to bring him.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Edgar Taether.

quests.~4076:
Neziroth Daggerhart had his prized ancestral coin stolen by bandits somewhere in Stowaway's Step. 

If you find it, return it to him near the Shrine to Vitheo.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Neziroth Daggerhart.

flags.~4082: What's this? A duplicate? This is definitely fake!

quests.~4076: Varran Juctor in Fernalla Field would like some of the beads he sees the Risen Druids behind him wearing. Bring him as many as you can find.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Varran Juctor.

quests.~4076: You have been told that it may be possible to combine an Eldrich crystal with an inert rune at the right place of power in order to power the rune once again.
Through Larviso, Sivakaya has shown you that Azynthi's corruption has taken hold of all of the Gods of Erenshor. Fernalla, Vitheo, Soluna, and Brax.

The Banker in Port Azure has asked you to make his travels safer in the world. He said that for any Essence of Amarion you bring to him, he will give you an Ethereal Vault to access his bank remotely.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Comstock Retalio.
Turn in items to Prestigio Valusha.

quests.~4076: You've heard a legend that if you were to approach the Gate of Fernalla with a worthy gift, it may open for you.
You've found a blueprint for an Azynthian Resting Place and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for an Azynthian Dining Room and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for an Azynthian Livingroom and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for an Expert Training Room and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for an Loomingwood Marketplace and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for a Smithy and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for a Stone Auction House and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for a Stone Bank and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for a Stone Dining Room and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for a Stone Fountain and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for a Stone Training Room and gave it to a furniture maker.
You've found a blueprint for a Stone Vendor and gave it to a furniture maker.

Nylith in Hidden Hills has asked for Faerie Dust from the nearby forest.

It could be dropped by any Faerie that you find.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Nylith Valorro.

flags.~4082: Already got it from ya! Thanks anyhow.

quests.~4076: You've powered your Fernallan Rune
Keep your eyes open for any intel on how or why Sivakayans are gaining access to Port Azure. Share it with Guard Captain Kilkay if you find it.

flags.~4082: You've shown me this.

quests.~4076: Handing a Riftsnare Gem to the Flickering Souls in Azynthi's Garden pulls them into full existence...

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Flicker of Souls.

quests.~4076:
A Stormcaller named Windlae in Hidden Hills has asked that you find and fell a beast in the Brake called Grizzlepaw.

She has observed a remnant of a chain stuck in the beast's teeth that may have belonged to a friend of hers.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Windlae Oldseer.

quests.~4076:
The village of Goodsoil in Fernalla's Revival Plane was destroyed by forces unknown. 

Rumors are abound, but figuring out what truly happened may take more time.
Benson Gamble in Hidden Hills is looking for Graveweed Leaf from the nearby Bonepits. It's located on the north side of Hidden Hills.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Benson Gamble.

quests.~4076: Hadden in Fernalla's Revival Plains has asked you to take a package of supplies to Ripper's Keep. They'll give you a receipt, and if you bring that back to Hadden he'll reward you.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Leena Halsted.

quests.~4076: Take the receipt of delivery from Ripper's Keep back to Hadden in Fernalla's Revival Plains.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Hadden Passican.

quests.~4076:
Go to the Gate and tell the Guard there that you've registered to gain a key to the pass through to the rest of Stowaway's Step. 

(To tell the guard you've registered, target him and press ENTER to type. Type 'I'm registered'.)

There is a group of people hidden underneath Port Azure near the docks. A spoken password is required for safe entry - it's "Shadowtide".

You should investigate when you're in the city.
You've heard rumors of an old tomb on the island that has attracted the attention of strange ritualists. It may be worth investigating if you can find it.
You have restored the Nighthollow Candle, but it is not lit. You must find a Braxonian Flame to ignite the wick and restore the Candle's true power.

flags.~4082: The flame does not respond

quests.~4076:
A recovered page of Sivakayan Intel was handed to Guard Captain Kilkay, who was appreciative of the info.

He has asked you to continue to search for information on how Sivakayans may be entering Port Azure.
A recovered page of Sivakayan Intel was handed to Guard Captain Kilkay, who was appreciative of the info.
A recovered journal of a Sivakayan Darkwardenl was handed to Guard Captain Kilkay, who was appreciative of the info.
Ripper asked for you to bring any information you find on Sivakayan activity to her.
A strange ghostly statue in the Jaws of Sivakaya claims to have 'awoken the guardian' and that you should let it look upon you for a moment.

steps.~4076: Speak to A Memory of Sivakaya.

quests.~4076: You have demonstrated your faith in Sivakaya's Gift to proceed into the inner church of the Jaws of Sivakaya.

flags.~4082: Your faith is noted.

quests.~4076: The statue of Sivakaya has gazed upon you.
You've achieved something impressive.

flags.~4082: No... not again!

quests.~4076:
Ripper DeMerth wants you to kill Guard Captain Kilkay in Port Azure, for his role in the abandonment of the Citizens of the North.

Return with proof of his demise.

flags.~4082: This is not anything I'm interested in taking from you.

quests.~4076: PLACEHOLDER FOR CONTINUATION
Deliver the deportation papers to Kio the Light Keeper at the Lighthouse and collect his Gate Key for your own use.

flags.~4082: You've done this to me already! Why rub it in?

quests.~4076: You are stranded on Stowaway's Step. There has to be a way off... You should ask around and see what you can learn.
You handed a fisherman his lunch in in return he mentioned he may share a pirate tale.

flags.~4082: You wanna hear the tale or not? You gotta ask or I'm not tellin! Had too many folks doze off at the good parts 'cause they didn't wanna hear it.

quests.~4076: You should ask the Shady Fisherman on the Port Azure docks to tell you a tale. He claims to have found something in the sea that may interest an adventurous person like you.

flags.~4082: Hope you're listenin' this time!

quests.~4076:
The Fisherman on the Azure Docks has promised you a trip to a lost Island in exchange for helping him finish his day's fishing quota. 

He needs 4 Octorunners.
You should find the recipient of this note, it looks as though it's never going to find its own way.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Liam Kilfa.

quests.~4076: You've been told that it's imperative to get the Loss Stone back to Lucian at Stowaway's Step.
Foreman Hauck in Port Azure has asked you to explore the Lost Cellar and find any Intel that may or may not exist down there. Bring it to him if you find it.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Foreman Hauck.

flags.~4082: Oh... they made copies of it? Good for the collection, I suppose.

quests.~4076: Handing an Essence of Lost Faith to a Stardust will take away its invulnerability.
Prichard Zemoro has asked you to bring him a treasure map and an elixir of enlightment II. He says he'll give you a Sivakrux for each combo you bring. Prichard is in the slums of Port Azure.

steps.~4076: Turn in items to Prichard Zemoro.

quests.~4076: There is a fisherman waiting for you under the cover of night in Blacksalt Strand to take you back to Stowaway's Step.

You've met a Shard of Sivakaya inside the portal at the Stowaway's Step Ritual. She warned you of a corruption taking over Erenshor, and asked that you help free the Gods who have touched this world. 

She faded out of existence after her warning, cautioning you of a manifesting corruption nearby.

You've made Malaroth Food with:
1 Octorunner
1 Frowney Clowney
1 Azure Mead
